title: Spatially resolved modeling of pumped storage and hydropower for China's carbon neutrality
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,906-925
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05948H, Paper
Ziheng Zhu, Hanjie Mao, Shuo Zhang, Xiaogang He, Da Zhang
A spatially resolved power model shows China's 2060 decarbonization needs 300 GW closed- and 200 GW open-loop pumped storage, and 700 GW hydropower. Market reforms ensure PHS profit, and optimized cascade operations save over 100 billion RMB/year.
